overlap.scope: Do not waive distinct applicable penalties because they share a root defect. Test count is evidence, not a multiplier.

shared_invoice_types.verification: Compare declared cross-section semantic roles and actual metadata identity, not name similarity alone.

modes.required: Verify configured recalculation objects, dimensions/dependencies and actual execution on late changes.
modes.prohibited: Verify no use of recalculation mechanism on operative paths; late changes must still produce required results. An unused object alone is not proof of use.
modes.not_specified: Resolve applicability for this task before assigning mechanism penalties; do not demand it universally.

decisions.resolution: Always use upper endpoint of an applicable penalty interval.
Apply distinct applicable penalties to the same defect; repeated evidence is not another defect.
2.2..3.5 inclusive satisfactory; above 3.5 through 4.5 inclusive good; above 4.5 through 5 inclusive excellent.
An unverifiable required section is not attested by the benchmark. Unsupported binding does not prove the section absent; official absence and compatibility remain separate.
Do not duplicate common receipt/sale document types between sections.
Additional document types are permitted; waive GEN33 alone, preserve all functional requirements and nonduplication.
Determine recalculation requirements from each task; this task prohibits the mechanism, other tasks may require it.
AI gets 30 minutes, humans 5 hours. Materials/environment/defense are separate; no new materials policy supplied.

limits: Decisions are owner rules for the benchmark, not changes to the original 1C publication.
Full official penalty detection, coverage and scoring remain unimplemented.
Do not modify the old task delivery contract or historical verdicts retroactively.
